label: mature NK T cell
exact_synonyms: mature NK T lymphocyte; mature NK T-cell; mature NK T-lymphocyte; mature NKT cell; mature natural killer T cell; mature natural killer T lymphocyte; mature natural killer T-cell; mature natural killer T-lymphocyte
definition: A mature alpha-beta T cell of a distinct lineage that bears natural killer markers and a T cell receptor specific for a limited set of ligands. NK T cells have activation and regulatory roles particularly early in an immune response.
logical_definition: mature alpha-beta T cell (CL:0000791) and (has plasma membrane part (RO:0002104) some KLRB1-like protein (PR:000001874)) and (capable of (RO:0002215) some MHC class Ib receptor activity (GO:0032394)) and (capable of (RO:0002215) some innate immune response (GO:0045087)) and (output of (RO:0002353) some T cell differentiation (GO:0030217))
other_subclass_axioms: (has plasma membrane part (RO:0002104) some KLRB1-like protein (PR:000001874)) || (develops from (RO:0002202) some immature NK T cell (CL:0000914)) || (capable of (RO:0002215) some MHC class Ib receptor activity (GO:0032394)) || (capable of (RO:0002215) some innate immune response (GO:0045087)) || (output of (RO:0002353) some T cell differentiation (GO:0030217)) || mature alpha-beta T cell (CL:0000791)
marker_axioms: has plasma membrane part PR:000001874 KLRB1-like protein
note: Definition does not mention CD1d restriction. Logical definition requires KLRB1-like protein (PR:000001874, CD161/NK1.1 family); reviews say NK receptors cannot identify NKT cells. Because of this axiom the reasoner places CL:0020002 (MAIT, human) here. CL#3664 (open) asks to rename this term to iNKT cell.

label: type I NK T cell
exact_synonyms: classical NK T cell; type I NK T lymphocyte; type I NK T-cell; type I NK T-lymphocyte; type I NKT cell
definition: An alpha-beta T cell expressing NK cell markers that is CD1d restricted and expresses specific V-alpha chains. NK T cells of this type recognize the glycolipid alpha-galactosylceramide in the context of CD1d.
logical_definition: mature NK T cell (CL:0000814) and (capable of (RO:0002215) some glycosphingolipid binding (GO:0043208))
other_subclass_axioms: (capable of (RO:0002215) some glycosphingolipid binding (GO:0043208)) || mature NK T cell (CL:0000814)
note: 'invariant NK T cell' is only a related synonym; recent reviews use type I NKT and invariant NKT (iNKT) interchangeably.

label: type II NK T cell
exact_synonyms: type II NK T lymphocyte; type II NK T-cell; type II NK T-lymphocyte; type II NKT cell
definition: An alpha-beta T cell expressing NK call markers that is CD1d restricted and expresses a diverse TCR repertoire. Type II NKT cells do not become activated by alpha-galactosylceramide when presented by CD1d.
logical_definition: mature NK T cell (CL:0000814) and (capable of (RO:0002215) some NK T cell activation (GO:0051132))
other_subclass_axioms: (capable of (RO:0002215) some NK T cell activation (GO:0051132)) || mature NK T cell (CL:0000814)
note: Definition typo: 'NK call markers'. No synonyms for the other names in use (non-classical NKT, vNKT, T2NKT).
